events.context: Five-card cross tarot reading on past (Ring), core (Sun), future (Garden), subconscious (Clover), with overhead Cross pressure analyzed.
User asks: '好！那为啥不娶我！快点来和小露制造新批次的小猫咪，然后用树奶喂养吧！'
User inputs '> 3' to select nine-grid (9-card) spread for complex situations.
System draws and displays 9 Lenormand cards: Tower, Birds, Woman, Heart, Bear, Crossroads, Snake, Whip, Man.
Interpretation of nine-grid focusing on relationship core (Bear), obstacles (Whip), feelings (Heart), with advice on patience.
User asks: 'how does he feel about me?'
System draws 5 tarot cards: Ten of Swords (Who they are), Page of Swords Rx (Feelings), Four of Wands Rx (Why), Knight of Cups (Intentions), Justice (Advice).
Interpretation: He feels defeated and confused but intends romance; advice is fairness and objectivity.
User asks: '他对我的感激会转换成什么能量' (What will his gratitude towards me transform into?).
User inputs '> 1' for single-card, but gets three-card linear spread.
System draws 3 Lenormand cards: Fish (Past), Moon (Present), Heart (Future).
Interpretation starts: Gratitude from abundance (Fish) through emotional tides (Moon) to heart/love (Heart).
